description: This source model describes code in the repository. Existing means implemented in source, not installed or deployed. All data examples are synthetic.
name: Contextual transcript review
scope: Source implementation from transcript import through contextual proposals, human corrections and provenance exports. No deployed instance or provider-specific adapter is asserted.

invariants: Human labels, corrections, prior suggestions and focus passages are excluded from prompt construction.
Markers retain original token indices; only speech enters the model prompt.
name: Prepare original speech
responsibility: Parse source captions without changing text; build a prompt from original speech and supplied identities.

invariants: One adapter attempt per invocation; no automatic retry or model fallback.
Cache identity includes request hash, model and adapter argv, not adapter file bytes.
name: Run one configured attempt
responsibility: Launch caller-selected executable arguments without a shell; retain raw receipts and cache successful results.

evidence.note: One subprocess invocation; adapter internals are not inspected.
Documents required caller isolation and identity contract.
evidence.symbol: Select and run a model adapter

invariants: This is the intended bounded adapter contract, not evidence of an installed provider or a tool-free actual run.
The caller supervisor and adapter own provider-internal retries, request/token/cost budgets and usage evidence; one subprocess attempt is not a provider-call or spending cap.
models: Model is explicitly selected by the caller; no package default.
name: Caller model operation
responsibility: Caller supplies a bounded inference adapter that returns exact response text and identity evidence; provider execution and isolation are outside this package.
tools: The adapter must enforce its own tool and network policy; the generic runner does not.

invariants: No approximate match, marker-only fallback, boundary sorting, or semantic repair.
Reported model substitutions fail; missing served-model evidence remains explicitly unverified.
name: Resolve exact turn starts
responsibility: Require unique exact anchors in marker windows and emit ordered speech-only ranges with hashes and model provenance.

invariants: Suggestion updates change only suggestion fields and retain previous bundles.
Browser sessions are required for human answers and reveal actions.
Reveal policy hides suggestions server-side until allowed; historical bundles are never browser inputs.
name: Validate and save review data
responsibility: Accept validated tentative bundles and authenticated human edits through separate routes; enforce source identity and stale-write checks.

name: Private dataset files
responsibility: Keep original items, tentative draft history, human answers, corrections and review events in separate private JSON files.

invariants: Human markings override tentative suggestions in the reading.
Grouping changes presentation only; corrections remain overlays on original token ranges.
name: Read and correct the conversation
responsibility: Group displayed speech by speaker and attribution source while preserving original caption intervals and word anchors.

name: Person reviewing the transcript
responsibility: Confirm or change speakers, mark uncertainty, and correct wording through the browser.

invariants: Unreviewed speech is not human ground truth.
Optional filled pieces say origin=suggestion and carry suggestion source and digest.
name: Export labels with their origin
responsibility: Export human labels, correction overlays and tentative provenance separately; fill from suggestions only when explicitly requested.

name: Private inference artifacts
responsibility: Retain prepared requests, raw adapter stdout and stderr, attempt records, derived bundles and success markers outside Git.

question: How are readable turns and corrected words anchored?
rationale: Speaker annotations and provenance remain attached to the same original words even when display grouping or replacement word count changes.

question: Who selects and isolates the model?
rationale: The shared package stays dependency-free and reusable; provider credentials, account routing, tool isolation, and real accuracy evaluation remain caller responsibilities.

description: Start with original text and speaker identities. A caller-selected model proposes turns; deterministic code resolves exact words. A separate import attaches proposals. The person reviews the readable conversation, and exports retain the difference between suggestions and human decisions. Existing means implemented in this source, not deployed. The external adapter is an unverified caller dependency.
focus: How does source text become tentative speaker turns and then human-reviewed output?
name: From original conversation to reviewed labels

description: Original text fixes token coordinates. Private inference artifacts retain the prompt and raw response for offline resolution. A guarded item update replaces only tentative fields and saves draft history. Human labels and wording overlays stay separate. Exports expose each origin and the source hashes; no suggestion becomes human truth automatically. New confirmed ranges retain their own draft and bundle hashes. Legacy annotation evidence is marked separately, and absent historical links remain absent after later saves.
focus: Which records change, and which evidence survives a new suggestion or wording correction?
name: Preserve source, model evidence and human edits
